decisions.reason: As a distant, highly niche product that was only briefly mentioned rather than fully promoted, submarine interior lighting looks less aligned with the firm's scalable core portfolio despite its broader maritime exposure.

A medical examination light extends the firm's professional lighting capabilities into an adjacent institutional segment and was given dedicated market presentation, which fits an expanding R&D-led firm.
Industrial explosion-proof luminaires are strongly consistent with the firm's industrial customer base, engineering strengths and focus on efficient, durable specialist lighting solutions.
The designer task light is close to the established offer and had already been relaunched as a popular product, suggesting proven demand worth retaining in the range.
